Slow it down, let it take its time,

[Verse 1
City lights are low, but a seed went in first,
Quiet in the dark, in the soil of the heart.
Before the page, before the print and the proof,
Something living landed, and it started from the root.
Not a noise, not a trend, not a thing that I built,
Planted deep inside me, now it’s moving like a pulse.
Sown before the sunrise, yeah, it’s sown in the night,
First comes the Word that is living, then the light.
Water it, feed it, let it grow,
What starts in the heart is what the fruit will show.
First sown, first sown, the Living Word,
Planted in the heart, and it’s heard, it’s heard.
Fed by the written Word, the bread and the wine,
Both are needed, but one comes first in line.
First sown, first sown, let it grow,
Roots going down where the rivers flow.
Living Word, Living Word, (YahuShua)
Fruit on the vine, and the harvest is true.
[Drop]
(Living… Living Word… Yahu-Yahu-Shua…)
(First… first sown…)
Written Word is the table, it’s the food and the drink,
Feeds what’s growing in me, helps me stand, helps me think.
Seed with no supply, it’ll starve in the sun,
Page with no seed is just ink on the run.
So I hold them together, but I know the order,
Heart gets the seed, then the page is my water.
Fruit don’t lie, it shows what’s inside,
Grown from the root, nothing fake, nothing tied.
Both are needed, one is first,
One is planted, one is the thirst-quencher.
